`ffnvcodec/dynlink_cuda.h` and `ffnvcodec/nvEncodeAPI.h` are unmodified copies from
[nv-codec-headers](https://github.com/FFmpeg/nv-codec-headers) tag `n12.1.14.0`
(NVENC API 12.1, the version FFmpeg 6.1 builds against; NVIDIA Linux driver 530.41 or newer).
MIT licensed, see the header comments. Only the in-process NVENC engine (`--features inproc-av`) uses them.
